chars.OMAR: OMAR: a 14-year-old Moroccan boy wearing a bright yellow hoodie with a black stripe across the chest, dark blue jeans and red sneakers.
chars.YOUSSEF: YOUSSEF: a 14-year-old Moroccan boy wearing a green and white Raja football jersey, black track pants and white sneakers.
chars.DAD: YOUSSEF'S FATHER: a middle-aged Moroccan man wearing a brown leather jacket over a white shirt, beige trousers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Split vertical composition: top half shows OMAR at night in his small Moroccan bedroom sitting at an old desktop computer, grinning mischievously, rubbing his hands; bottom half shows YOUSSEF in his own bedroom lying on his bed, happily chatting on his phone, totally trusting.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: YOUSSEF sitting on his bed staring at his glowing phone with huge excited eyes and a big open-mouth smile, as if he found an amazing cheap deal, a game controller beside him.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan living room with low sofas and a carpet, YOUSSEF tiptoes behind his father who is asleep on the sofa, sneakily pulling a bank card out of the father's wallet on the table, nervous guilty face.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: YOUSSEF hiding behind a door, holding his father's blank bank card in one hand and typing on his phone with the other, looking over his shoulder nervously.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: OMAR hurrying home through a narrow street of a small Moroccan town (Sidi Bennour) at dusk, small shops and a mosque minaret behind, eyes wide, half excited half scared.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: OMAR in his dark bedroom at the old desktop computer, wearing his hood up, face lit by green light from the monitor, typing fast like a movie hacker, smug grin.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Close view of OMAR at the computer holding a phone showing a bank card photo, carefully copying it, biting his lip in concentration, sweat drop on his head.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: OMAR jumping up from his chair with both fists in the air, celebrating wildly, gaming headset around his neck, colourful game glow from the monitor.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: OMAR leaning very close to the monitor with greedy sparkling eyes and a sly smile, rubbing his hands, surrounded by floating game coins and gift boxes.

scenes.name: n10.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan school corridor with blue lockers-free walls and a green chalkboard visible through a door, YOUSSEF storms toward OMAR with an angry red face and clenched fists, while OMAR freezes with a fake innocent smile, sweating.
